title: The Invoker and the Satyr

texts.details:
Two more lead the Searing Blade, and they are the ones who do its thinking.

Jergosh the Invoker is an orc warlock. He is the reason I do not take the Horde's word that it has put demons behind it; there are still orcs who would drink that cup again. Bazzalan is a satyr, and what one of those is doing in the pay of orcish cultists I would dearly like to know. You will not be able to ask him.

They keep to the deepest part of the chasm, past where the felguard stood. Kill both, $N, and the Shadow Council loses its foothold under that city.
texts.objectives: Kill Jergosh the Invoker and Bazzalan in Ragefire Chasm, then return to Master Mathias Shaw in Old Town, Stormwind.
texts.progress: Deeper than the felguard. They will not be alone.
texts.completion:
Both. Then the Searing Blade has no head, and the Shadow Council has one less hole to hide in.

I will see that a word of this reaches the right ear in Orgrimmar, by a road that cannot be traced to us. Let the Warchief wonder who did his work for him.

You have done the Alliance a service it will never thank you for in public, $N. SI:7 does its thanking in private.

idea: Ragefire Chasm, 2 of 2 for the Alliance: Jergosh the Invoker and the satyr Bazzalan, leaders of the Searing Blade; Thrall also wants the cult destroyed.
